title: Entry
description: A single journal entry as persisted and returned by GET /api/entries/{id}.

created_at.description: UTC timestamp the row was inserted (YYYY-MM-DD HH:MM:SS).

entry_date.description: The day the entry is about (may be backdated). Defaults to today.

mood.description: Optional mood, 1 (a hard day) to 5 (a bright day).

reflection.description: The AI (or fallback) reflection generated at save time.

entities.description: Entities mentioned in this entry (id + name + type).
